title: On the Selection of Arbitrators

original_source.version_note: Complete original abstract only; full body inaccessible through attempted publisher/author routes.

central_claims: Sequential shortlisting for arbitrator selection has better implementation properties and experimental outcomes than simultaneous veto-rank procedures.

source_manifest.title: On the Selection of Arbitrators
source_manifest.finding: Original central claims were recorded before follow-up grading.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. Evaluating replicability of laboratory experiments in economics — Supplement, Tables S1–S2
source_manifest.finding: The preregistered independent comparison tests whether shortlisting improves aggregate payoffs over veto-rank for preference profile Pf2; replication N=156, original focal N=158, p=<.001. The project only retested one selected result per paper.
